title: matplotlib: a line chart
source:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

months = ["Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May", "Jun"]
rain_mm = [42, 55, 80, 120, 95, 60]

plt.plot(months, rain_mm, marker="o")
plt.title("Rainfall by month")
plt.xlabel("Month")
plt.ylabel("Rainfall (mm)")
plt.show()
print("Wettest month:", months[rain_mm.index(max(rain_mm))])

steps.narration: months now refers to a new list.
rain_mm now refers to a new list.
Drew a line plot of rain_mm against months on the current axes.
Set the title of the current axes to "Rainfall by month".
Set the x-axis label of the current axes to "Month".
Set the y-axis label of the current axes to "Rainfall (mm)".
Figure 1 is in the output: a line plot titled Rainfall by month, with the x axis labelled Month and the y axis Rainfall (mm).
